engine_stated_criteria: check whether AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business
answer_verbatim:
If you want to **check whether AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business**, the most relevant type of service is an **AI visibility / AEO (answer engine optimization) monitoring tool**, not a general AI consulting or readiness assessment service.[12][14][10]

For a small business, the strongest fit in the results is **Brand Performance** from the AEO tools comparison, because it **generates prompts from your domain and tracks weekly AI responses across ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini, and Perplexity**.[12] That makes it directly aligned with your goal of seeing whether AI systems mention or recommend your business.[12]

If you want the best option by practical value, the comparison suggests a few tiers:

| Option | Best for | Why it fits |
|---|---|---|
| **Brand Performance** | Ongoing AI recommendation tracking | Tracks responses across multiple AI engines, including ChatGPT.[12] |
| **Semrush AI Visibility** | Broader SEO + AI visibility monitoring | Offers prompt research, competitor research, and site audit, though it is less focused on small-business-specific recommendation tracking.[12] |
| **HubSpot AEO** | Small businesses already using HubSpot | Adds CRM integration and prioritized recommendations, but covers fewer engines.[12] |
| **Manual testing** | Lowest cost | Free, but the source notes it is time-consuming and inconsistent.[12] |

If you want a single recommendation, **Brand Performance** appears to be the best match for your use case because it is built to monitor how your business appears in AI responses, rather than just assess your internal AI readiness.[12] If you want a more budget-conscious setup and already use marketing tools, **Semrush AI Visibility** or **HubSpot AEO** may be better depending on your stack.[12]

If you want, I can also give you a **2-minute shortlist** based on your budget and whether you care more about **ChatGPT only** or **ChatGPT + other AI engines**.
